overall_reason: Carbon's UI shell ships intact: a fixed header with search and a named 'Open menu' button at 375, a side nav whose disclosures open and close on Escape, and text-and-arrow tiles as the only actions; the one doubtful component is a fixed back-to-top button.

score.reason: T-PHONE-NAV, T-OVERLAY-CHECK and T-PRIMARY-COUNT pass on the Carbon shell. T-INTERRUPT finds one fixed back-to-top button (CMP-183), and the search and site switcher could not be checked.

findings.where: fixed 'Back to top' button, bottom right, 1440px, tiles/1440-04.png and tiles/1440-05.png
findings.evidence: A 48 px dark round 'Back to top' button stays fixed at the bottom right once the page scrolls. It overlaps the content area on every later tile. The sweep's focus_ring check reports 'Back to top' as partly hidden by a fixed element.
findings.before: A floating back-to-top button rides over the content on every screen after the first.
findings.after: Drop the floating button: the fixed header and side nav already give a way back. Or place a 'Back to top' link at the end of the page.
findings.why: A fixed control over the content hides what sits under it.
findings.title: No popups, newsletter modals, chat bubbles, help pills, back-to-top squares

strengths: The side nav groups 'Getting started', 'Building blocks', 'Building experiences' and 'Support' as disclosures that open and close on Escape (overlays t1 and t2, closed_after_escape: true).
At 375 the side nav folds behind a named 'Open menu' button (48x48), and the header keeps search, Login and the site switcher (tiles/375-00.png).
The home page has no filled buttons: the actions are text tiles with an arrow ('Start designing', 'Start developing'), one family throughout (tiles/1440-00.png).
not_investigated: 'Switch sites' (the grid icon) and 'Cookie Preferences' opened nothing when clicked, and the footer counts one dead link. The capture blocked IBM and Carbon scripts (a webpack chunk, ibm-common.js, bluemix-analytics), so these are capture context
the header search navigated away when clicked: not verified
